name: Flash Marriage To My Lady Boss
original_name: Flash Marriage To My Lady Boss
overview: It all starts with Mateo, unceremoniously abandoned by his girlfriend, when fate pushes him into a whirlwind marriage with Valeria Soto, a cold and powerful CEO. What seems like an impulsive deal soon morphs into something bigger: an amulet reveals that Mateo is actually Miguel Ríos, the missing heir of the Ríos Group. From that moment on, the story accelerates without brakes: banquets full of hidden glances, identities that come to light and the mysterious figure of Zorro, who connects past and present in a single emotional blow.
